`not` written by the follow power (issue 01a1690b-4745). `not` is a term
(perly.y's `NOTOP listexpr`): nothing before it splits it, and its operand
runs right until a looser `and`, `or` or `xor`. Canon writes it bare, groups
it only when a tighter operator follows, and keeps a parenthesised operand's
parens, which perl reads as `not (X)`, tighter. Each snippet's Deparse,-p is
perl 5.44.0's.

=== not before a looser or
not $x or $z;
--- facts
faithful
# ($x and $z);
# perl's void-context rewrite of `!$x or $z`: `not` took $x alone.

=== not in an initialiser before a looser or
my $v = not $x or 1;
--- facts
faithful
# ((my $v = (!$x)) or '???');

=== not with a parenthesised operand before a tighter plus
not ($y) + 1;
--- facts
faithful
# ((!$y) + 1);

=== not with a parenthesised comparison before a tighter plus
not ($a == 1) + 1;
--- facts
faithful
# ((!($a == 1)) + 1);

=== not takes a tighter comparison
not $x == 1;
--- facts
faithful
# not(($x == 1));

=== not grouped by the source before a tighter comparison
(not $x) == 1;
--- facts
faithful
# ((!$x) == 1);

=== not under a list operator
print not $x;
--- facts
faithful
# print((!$x));

=== not takes the whole comma list under a list operator
print not $x, $y;
--- facts
faithful
# print((!($x, $y)));

=== not under a high-precedence not
!not $x;
--- facts
faithful
# not((!$x));

=== not as a ternary's middle part
$c ? not $x : 1;
--- facts
faithful
# ($c ? (!$x) : '???');

=== not at a right operand takes the comma list
$a + not $x, $y;
--- facts
faithful
# ($a + (!($x, $y)));

=== not of not
not not $x;
--- facts
faithful
# not((!$x));

=== not takes a repetition
not $x x 3;
--- facts
faithful
# not(($x x 3));

=== not inside a parenthesised list
my @l = (not $x, 1);
--- facts
faithful
# (my(@l) = (!($x, 1)));

=== not grouped before a bracketed list's comma
my $r = [(not $x), 1];
--- facts
faithful
# (my($r) = [(!$x), 1]);

=== not inside an arrow call's argument parens
$f->(not $x);
--- facts
faithful
# &$f((!$x));

=== not with a parenthesised operand before a tighter repetition
not ($x) x 2;
--- facts
faithful
# ((!$x) x 2);

=== a parenthesised not as an arrow call's first argument
$f->((not $x), 1);
--- facts
faithful
# &$f((!$x), 1);

=== not of a parenthesised sum that opens with a paren
not ((1) + 1);
--- facts
faithful
# '???';
# perl folded the constant; with a variable, `not (($y) + 1)` is
# not(($y + 1)).

=== not as a ternary's last part takes the comma list
[$c ? 1 : not $x, 2];
--- facts
faithful
# [($c ? 1 : (!($x, 2)))];

=== not takes a ternary holding another not
not $x ? not $y : $z;
--- facts
faithful
# not(($x ? (!$y) : $z));

=== not after a list operator's filehandle
print STDOUT not $x;
--- facts
faithful
# print(STDOUT (!$x));

=== not with a parenthesised operand before a subscript arrow
not ($x)->[0];
--- facts
faithful
# +(!$x)->[0];
